name: Sakamoto Ryouma
source:
A warrior from the Tosa domain who wants Japan to be open to the world. The Shinsen-gumi consider him dangerous. He loves the unique and unusual, and has a strong interest in the world beyond Japan. His sullen attitude masks how sweet he can be with those he trusts.

[Taken from [url=https://www.cyikemen.com/DestinedToLove/pc/index.html]official website[/url]]
